title: Finite = integral + locally of finite type
statement: A morphism of schemes $f:X\to Y$ is finite if and only if it is integral [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] and locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism].

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 01WJ (label lemma-finite-integral): a finite morphism is integral, and an integral morphism locally of finite type is finite; and a finite morphism is locally of finite type since a finite ring map is of finite type (Algebra, Lemma 0D46, label algebra-lemma-finite-finite-type)
